title: David B NDE 7395
content: I woke up in the morning and said good morning. The next thing I remember was seeing myself lying in an ambulance. I was above the ambulance and myself. I could see through the top of the ambulance, myself lying there, and the Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) trying to save my life. Then I was on the hospital lawn noticing that everything was really colorful, bright and vivid. Then everything changed to a bright gray: the sky, the ground, everything. I went forward, not really walking, but just moving. My grandmother was in front of me smiling. Behind her, I could see lots and lots of people. They were not really people, but shapes of them in a cloudy grey-color. I could feel them and the excitement and happiness coming from them. I could feel that I knew them and they were waiting for me. My grandmother was smiling as she said, 'It is not your time yet, you have a few more things to achieve.' Then it was as if everything went into reverse. I woke up in the hospital. During this whole experience, I felt nothing and didn't realize what was happening. It was more like 'confusion' without being confused.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported being above the ambulance and seeing himself lying in it.

arrival.other_being_detail: He saw 'lots and lots of people' as cloudy grey shapes and felt he knew them.

environment.environment_other_detail: Hospital lawn was 'really colorful, bright and vivid' and then shifted to a 'bright gray' sky/ground/everything.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He described it as 'everything went into reverse' and then he woke up in the hospital.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Grandmother said: 'It is not your time yet, you have a few more things to achieve.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Scene shift to hospital lawn with vivid colors, then bright gray realm with many cloudy-shape beings; 'reverse' return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above ambulance → hospital lawn (vivid colors) → gray realm with grandmother and many beings → message to return → reverse return → woke in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported feeling 'nothing' and described it as 'confusion' without being confused; also a visual shift from vivid colors to uniform bright gray, and the return as 'everything went into reverse.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'It is not your time yet, you have a few more things to achieve.'; 'It was more like "confusion" without being confused.'
